verdict: Maybe, for founders comfortable with government sales. Road Bounce pitched a mobile app that measures road roughness through phone vibrations on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. City and highway authorities need data on road condition, but government sales cycles are long.
angle: Road authorities spend large sums on maintenance with little data. Crowd-sourced or vehicle-mounted sensors can map potholes cheaply. Municipal corporations, highway authorities and contractors are buyers.
